questions.question: Have you noticed any sweet or fruity smells that you don't really recognize on your child's stuff?
Have you noticed these smells lingering a lot around your child's room, backpack, or personal items over the last few days?
Is your child suddenly starting to cough a lot and have a very dry mouth?
Is this coughing interfering a lot with things like speaking and eating?
Has your child been trying to be very secretive or conceal where they go and what they do?
Are they spending time away from family a lot without any explanation consistently?
Is your child using some new item that you don't recognize? (vapes can be disguised as stuff like USB's and pens)
If so, are they trying a lot to conceal that item when you ask about it or if you are nearby?
Do you notice metal or plastic pods around your child's stuff?
Are they frequently discarded or in places that you would typically hide something?
Is your child starting to use a lot more gum and mints than usual?
Are they using these mints most frequently when arriving or leaving the house?
Is your child experiencing a lot of mood swings? (These could be just adolescence)
Are these mood swings mostly happening after coming back from school or just being alone in general?
Have you caught your child watching a lot of vaping videos?
Have you caught them discussing vaping techniques or watching these videos with friends? (Most illicit activities happen with friends due to peer pressure)
